label: FP
reason: The XSS vulnerability claim is based on a misinterpretation of the data flow. The user-controlled parameter 'param' is only assigned to 'bar' under specific conditional logic (if (500 / 42) + num > 200), which evaluates to false since (500 / 42) ≈ 11.9 and 11.9 + 196 ≤ 200. Thus, 'bar' is always set to "This should never happen", preventing user input from reaching the HTML output.

evidence.note: Conditional assignment prevents user input from flowing into bar; only executed if (500 / 42) + num > 200, which does not hold true
